About

Beauty, style and little moments

Ruqiyya Bafagih is a Doha-based content creator with a passion for self-care, beauty, modest fashion and wellbeing. She shares honest recommendations and connects her community with brands that match her values.

Her audience trusts her because she is transparent and relatable. Followers across Qatar and the Gulf, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh and Muscat, come to her for content that adds real value.
